```text
FQHESphereWithSpinCorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereWithSpinCorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --state : name of the file that contains the state whose average L value has to be evaluated
    --coefficients-only : only compute the one or two body coefficients that are requested to evaluate the density-density correlation
    -b, --bilayer : adjust normalization as a bilayer correlation function
    --shift : calculate 'shift' as defined for bilayer states
    -n, --nbr-points : number of point to evaluate (default value = 1000)
    -r, --radians : set units to radians instead of magnetic lengths
    --density : plot density insted of density-density correlation
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -l, --lzmax : twice the maximum momentum for a single particle (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -z, --total-lz : twice the total lz value of the system (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -s, --total-sz : twice the z component of the total spin of the system (0 if it has to be guessed from file name) (default value = 0)
    -A, --all-sz : assume a hilbert space including all sz values
    --pair-parity : parity for N_up as compared to int(N/2) (0=same, 1=different, -1=none) (default value = -1)
    --statistics : particle statistics (bosons or fermions, try to guess it from file name if not defined)
    --lzsymmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0, override auto-detection from file name)
    --szsymmetrized-basis : use Sz <-> -Sz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-sz=0, override auto-detection from file name)
    --minus-szparity : select the  Sz <-> -Sz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --minus-lzparity : select the  Lz <-> -Lz symmetric sector with negative parity
    --use-alt : use alternative Hilbert space for  bosonic states
    --show-extracted : show values extracted from file name

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Haldane basis)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with rhorho extension

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
